verdict.rationale: LobeChat documents a public REST API with OpenAPI spec, a CLI to operate an existing instance, and task-tool automation via CLI, showing meaningful programmatic access beyond the UI. However, there is no explicit claim or evidence of full feature parity between API/CLI and UI (e.g., dashboard, workspace collaboration, agent building flows are UI-only features not shown as API-exposed). Missing for 10: explicit parity documentation, coverage of workspace/agent-builder features via API, independent confirmation of completeness.
